Carmen — thanks, high priority. I pulled together a short package below and attached a sample CSV and diagram. Key points up front:

1) Metering events we report to AWS: per-customer SaaS units are emitted once-per-billable-operation (we support per-minute and per-invocation depending on the product SKU). For BrightSlate the agreed SKU is "Redwood Inference - Production Instance (vCPU-mins)" which maps to a tenant_id (BrightSlate account UUID) that we include in the payload to AWS.

2) Frequency & payload: We batch daily and push a single aggregated usage record per tenant to AWS Marketplace Metering API. Each record contains: tenant_id, sku_id, usage_start, usage_end, quantity, and a usage_signature (HMAC). Batching reduces noise and aligns with AWS reporting best practices.

3) Evidence sample: attached evidence-sample-logs.csv shows the raw daily aggregation prior to transformation and the final CSV we submit. The attached diagram (metering-implementation-diagram.png) shows where in the pipeline we sign and checkpoint events.

4) Billing flow: With the current plan we use the AWS Marketplace SaaS fulfillment model. That means BrightSlate will see charges through their AWS consolidated bill and AWS remits revenue to Redwood after marketplace fees. Redwood will not issue separate invoices for AWS-metered usage. For any professional services or add-ons outside the marketplace SKU (e.g., onboarding services) we can invoice BrightSlate directly — I'll flag those as separate line items in the SOW.

5) SLA & auditability: We keep 12 months of signed usage records and full raw logs for 18 months. We can produce signed CSV extracts on request for audit. Attached is a short SLA excerpt in Redwood_AWS_Marketplace_SaaS_Fulfillment_SLA.pdf.

Action items:
- Carmen: confirm if a single daily aggregate per tenant is acceptable to procurement (they said they prefer daily vs per-minute).
- Marissa / Soojin: can you confirm process for handing off proof-of-evidence to AWS PM if they request independent verification?

Thanks — I’ll be available for a quick call if useful.
